```{r Load Libraries}

library(stringr)

library(arrow) 
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
```

```{r Load CSV and Parquet}
df <- readr::read_csv(" DS_Project.csv")
write_parquet(df, "DS_Project.parquet")
```

Always read csv from parquet.

```{r Read parquet}
df <- arrow::read_parquet("DS_Project.parquet")
```

Plotting helper

```{r Plotting helper}
plot_confidence_bar <- function(tbl, title=NULL) {
  plot_ly(tbl, x=~Response, y=~agg_percent, type="bar",
          error_y = list(type="data",
                         array = tbl$high_CI - tbl$agg_percent,
                         arrayminus = tbl$agg_percent - tbl$low_CI)) %>%
    layout(title=title, yaxis=list(title="Percentage (%)"))
}

```

Question list for selectors

```{r Question list}

get_questions_list <- function(df) {
  df %>% pull(Question) %>% unique()
}

```

Load helpers

```{r Define source}
source("Helper_fns.R")
```

Read parquet

```{r read Parquet}
df <- arrow::read_parquet("DS_Project.parquet")
```

Apply merge cleaning functions

```{r Merge cleaners}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    ResponseID = merge_ResponseID(ResponseID),
    Response   = merge_Response(ResponseID, Response),
    BreakoutID = merge_BreakoutID(BreakoutID),
    Break_Out  = merge_Break_Out(BreakoutID, Break_Out)
  )

print(names(df))
```

UI:

```{r UI}

# ------------- UI (With Vertical Tab Boxes + Light Gray Header) -------------

classes <- df %>% distinct(Class) %>% pull(Class) %>% sort()

ui <- fluidPage(

  # ==== Custom CSS & JS for vertical tabs ====
  tags$head(
    tags$style(HTML("
      
      .title-box h1 {
        color: white !important;

      }

        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        padding: 12px 16px;

    ",

    # TITLE
    div(

         style = "color: white  !important; text-align:center; margin-top:10px; margin-bottom:25px;")
    ),

    # Dropdown Row 1
fluidRow(

                selectInput("class", "Class", choices = classes))),

),

    # ---- Button Row 2 ----
    fluidRow(
      column(
        width = 12,
        align = "center",
        actionButton(
          "refresh", "Refresh",
          class = "btn-primary",
          style = "margin-right:15px; margin-top:15px;"
        ),
        downloadButton("download_data", "Download Summary CSV",
                       style = "margin-top:15px;")
      )
    )
  ),

  # Horizontal Separator
  tags$hr(style = "margin-top:10px; margin-bottom:20px;"),

  # ==== Vertical Tabs + Graph Panel Layout ====
  fluidRow(

    # LEFT — VERTICAL TABS
    column(
      width = 2,
      style = "background-color: white; border-right:1px solid #ddd; min-height:700px;",

      actionButton("tab_overall",  "Overall",             class="vtab", width="100%"),
      actionButton("tab_gender",   "Gender",              class="vtab", width="100%"),
      actionButton("tab_age",      "Age Group",           class="vtab", width="100%"),
      actionButton("tab_race",     "Race / Ethnicity",    class="vtab", width="100%"),
      actionButton("tab_education","Education",           class="vtab", width="100%"),
      actionButton("tab_income",   "Income Level",        class="vtab", width="100%"),
      actionButton("tab_temporal", "Temporal Trends",     class="vtab", width="100%"),
      actionButton("tab_states",   "States / Territories",class="vtab", width="100%")
    ),

    # RIGHT — GRAPH OUTPUT
    column(
      width = 10,
      style = "background-color: white;",
      uiOutput("graph_panel")
    )
  )
)
```

```{r Server}
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # ======================================================
  #      DROPDOWNS: Topic + Question depend on prior
  # ======================================================

  output$topic_ui <- renderUI({
    req(input$class)
    tops <- df %>% filter(Class == input$class) %>% distinct(Topic) %>% pull(Topic)
    selectInput("topic", "Topic", choices = tops, selected = NULL)
  })

  output$question_ui <- renderUI({
    req(input$class, input$topic)
    qs <- df %>% filter(Class == input$class, Topic == input$topic) %>% distinct(Question) %>% pull(Question)
    selectInput("question", "Question", choices = qs, selected = NULL)
  })

  # Reactive question
  selected_question <- reactive({
    req(input$class, input$topic, input$question)
    input$question
  })


  # ======================================================
  #                FILE DOWNLOAD
  # ======================================================

  output$download_data <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {
      paste0("BRFSS_summary_",
             gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", selected_question()),
             ".csv")
    },
    content = function(file) {
      tbl <- aggregate_question(df, selected_question())
      write.csv(tbl, file, row.names = FALSE)
    }
  )


  # ======================================================
  #       VERTICAL TABS via actionButtons
  # ======================================================

  active_tab <- reactiveVal("overall")

  observeEvent(input$tab_overall,   active_tab("overall"))
  observeEvent(input$tab_gender,    active_tab("gender"))
  observeEvent(input$tab_age,       active_tab("age"))
  observeEvent(input$tab_race,      active_tab("race"))
  observeEvent(input$tab_education, active_tab("education"))
  observeEvent(input$tab_income,    active_tab("income"))
  observeEvent(input$tab_temporal,  active_tab("temporal"))
  observeEvent(input$tab_states,    active_tab("location"))

  observe({
    session$sendCustomMessage("updateVTab", paste0("tab_", active_tab()))
  })


  # ======================================================
  #               GRAPH PANEL SWITCHER
  # ======================================================

  output$graph_panel <- renderUI({
    switch(active_tab(),
           "overall"   = plotlyOutput("overall_plot"),
           "gender"    = plotlyOutput("gender_plot"),
           "age"       = plotlyOutput("age_plot"),
           "race"      = plotlyOutput("race_plot"),
           "education" = plotlyOutput("education_plot"),
           "income"    = plotlyOutput("income_plot"),
           "temporal"  = plotlyOutput("temporal_plot"),
           "location"  = plotlyOutput("location_map")   # MAP HERE
    )
  })


  # ======================================================
  #               PLOTS — AUTO RENDER
  # ======================================================

  # ---- Overall ----
  output$overall_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(selected_question())
    q <- selected_question()
    tbl <- aggregate_question(df, q)

    safe_plot(tbl,
              function(t) plot_category_panel(t, paste("Overall —", q)),
              q)
  })

  # ---- Gender ----
  output$gender_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(selected_question())
    q <- selected_question()
    tbl <- aggregate_by_category(df, q, "CAT2")

    safe_plot(tbl,
              function(t) plot_category_panel(t, paste("By Gender —", q)),
              q)
  })

  # ---- Age ----
  output$age_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(selected_question())
    q <- selected_question()
    tbl <- aggregate_by_category(df, q, "CAT3")

    # Less detail collapse
    if (input$detail_level == "Less" && nrow(tbl) > 0) {
      tbl <- tbl %>%
        mutate(Break_Out =
                 case_when(
                   Break_Out %in% c("18-24","25-34") ~ "18–34",
                   Break_Out %in% c("35-44","45-54") ~ "35–54",
                   TRUE ~ Break_Out)) %>%
        group_by(Break_Out, Response) %>%
        summarise(
          agg_percent = mean(agg_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
          low_CI = mean(low_CI, na.rm = TRUE),
          high_CI = mean(high_CI, na.rm = TRUE),
          .groups = "drop"
        )
    }

    safe_plot(tbl,
              function(t) plot_category_panel(t, paste("By Age Group —", q)),
              q)
  })

  # ---- Race ----
  output$race_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(selected_question())
    q <- selected_question()
    tbl <- aggregate_by_category(df, q, "CAT4")

    safe_plot(tbl,
              function(t) plot_category_panel(t, paste("By Race —", q)),
              q)
  })

  # ---- Education ----
  output$education_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(selected_question())
    q <- selected_question()
    tbl <- aggregate_by_category(df, q, "CAT5")

    safe_plot(tbl,
              function(t) plot_category_panel(t, paste("By Education —", q)),
              q)
  })

  # ---- Income ----
  output$income_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(selected_question())
    q <- selected_question()
    tbl <- aggregate_by_category(df, q, "CAT6")

    safe_plot(tbl,
              function(t) plot_category_panel(t, paste("By Income —", q)),
              q)
  })

  # ---- Temporal ----
  output$temporal_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(selected_question())
    q <- selected_question()
    tbl <- aggregate_by_year(df, q)

    safe_plot(tbl,
              function(t) plot_temporal_panel(t, paste("Trends Over Years —", q)),
              q)
  })

  # ======================================================
  #      STATES / TERRITORIES — U.S. CHOROPLETH MAP
  # ======================================================

  output$location_map <- renderPlotly({
    req(selected_question())
    q <- selected_question()

    tbl <- aggregate_by_location(df, q)

    safe_plot(tbl,
      function(t) {

        # Plotly USA map
        plot_ly(
          t,
          type = "choropleth",
          locations = ~Locationabbr,
          locationmode = "USA-states",
          z = ~agg_percent,
      text      = ~paste(Locationabbr, "<br>",
                         Response, "<br>",
                         round(agg_percent, 1), "%"),
          color = ~agg_percent,
          colorscale = "Blues",
          marker = list(line = list(color = "white", width = 1))
        ) %>%
          layout(
            geo = list(scope = "usa"),
            title = paste("By State —", q)
          )

      },
      q
    )
  })

}
```

```{r Dashboard}
shinyApp(ui,server)
```
